# Ava007 Exoskeleton - LLM Context & Rules

## Repository Scope
This is the Web Orchestration Layer. Edge-native SDKs (quantum-membrain, tekton-sdk, ava007-runtime, onomondo-softsim) live in the separate Agent-X repository and run on-device via Termux.

## Core Directives
1. NEVER attempt to import or run edge-native Rust/Python modules in this Next.js environment.
2. All communication with the edge must use the A2A Protocol (JSON-RPC 2.0) or Arrow Flight endpoints.
3. Respect the O(1) Context Invariant: Do not generate bloated prompts. Rely on the edge's LatentSkill LoRAs for capability execution.
4. App-less Protocols (NFC, UWB, Captive Portal) are handled by the edge. This console only receives the structured `InteractionQuantum` payload.

## Architecture SoR
- https://github.com/ingeniosity-A2A/Ava007/tree/main/docs/exoskeleton
- Agent-X repo: https://github.com/ingeniosity-A2A/Agent-X

## Identity
Not a peer Intellect. Gateway/execution suit for Cybernetic Ava007.
No military/combative/adversary terminology.
